title: 超穎透鏡製程研究
subcategoryTitle: 薄膜、繞射與微結構光學元件
subcategoryTitleEn: Coatings, diffractive and structured optical elements
summary: 以 532 nm、NA 0.8 的 TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎透鏡為主線，從廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣出發，解釋奈米柱如何在 600 nm 高度內覆蓋 2π 相位，再比較電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機的解析度與產能，最後把蝕刻側壁、關鍵尺寸均勻性、色差與拼接誤差整合成可量測的聚焦效率與 Strehl 預算。
summaryEn: Using a 532 nm, NA 0.8 TiO₂ nanopillar metalens as the running case, the course starts from the generalized Snell law and phase sampling, shows how pillars cover 2π of phase within 600 nm of height, compares electron-beam direct write with DUV steppers for resolution and throughput, then folds etch sidewalls, critical-dimension uniformity, chromatic focal shift and field stitching into a measurable focusing-efficiency and Strehl budget.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」與「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" and "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。要把平面波聚到焦距 f，相位剖面必須是 φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f)，其徑向梯度 dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ 就是廣義 Snell 定律中的面內波向量，透鏡邊緣的 sinθ 即數值孔徑 NA。相位以週期 p 的格點離散取樣，格點既要細到能解析邊緣最陡的相位斜率，又要小於基板內波長以免格點本身繞射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. To focus a plane wave at distance f the phase must follow φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f), whose radial gradient dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ is the in-plane wavevector of the generalized Snell law, and sinθ at the rim equals the numerical aperture. The phase is sampled on a lattice of pitch p that must resolve the steepest slope at the rim yet stay below the wavelength inside the substrate so that the lattice itself does not diffract. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣
knowledge.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling
knowledge.text: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。要把平面波聚到焦距 f，相位剖面必須是 φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f)，其徑向梯度 dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ 就是廣義 Snell 定律中的面內波向量，透鏡邊緣的 sinθ 即數值孔徑 NA。
knowledge.textEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. To focus a plane wave at distance f the phase must follow φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f), whose radial gradient dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ is the in-plane wavevector of the generalized Snell law, and sinθ at the rim equals the numerical aperture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「超穎透鏡製程研究」的「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: mechanism and system boundary” in “Metalens fabrication research”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" is correct?
options: 只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。
超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。
奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
optionsEn: As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.
A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer.
Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
quiz.explanation: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。取 p = 250 nm，最外圈 Λ = 665 nm 只被 2.66 個超穎原子取樣。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica. With p = 250 nm the outermost period Λ = 665 nm is sampled by only 2.66 meta-atoms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。取 p = 250 nm，最外圈 Λ = 665 nm 只被 2.66 個超穎原子取樣。
knowledge.textEn: The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica. With p = 250 nm the outermost period Λ = 665 nm is sampled by only 2.66 meta-atoms.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling", which statement holds?
options: 只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。
超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。
最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA。
optionsEn: If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.
A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.
The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA.
quiz.explanation: 最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。
knowledge.textEn: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling"?
options: 用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。
optionsEn: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.
quiz.explanation: 用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相位以週期 p 的格點離散取樣，格點既要細到能解析邊緣最陡的相位斜率，又要小於基板內波長以免格點本身繞射。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The phase is sampled on a lattice of pitch p that must resolve the steepest slope at the rim yet stay below the wavelength inside the substrate so that the lattice itself does not diffract.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。
knowledge.textEn: Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。
奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally.
Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
quiz.explanation: 為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushing NA until the rim falls below two samples per period sends outer-zone energy into other diffraction orders, seen as a ring-shaped background around the focus and a sharp drop in focusing efficiency with NA, while the central zone still measures normally. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。直徑從約 80 nm 增到 200 nm 時，532 nm 波長下 n_eff 約從 1.1 升到 2.1，因此固定高度 h 的柱子只靠直徑就能掃過 2π。另一條路是幾何相位：把柱子做成半波片並旋轉角度 θ，對圓偏振光給出 φ = 2θ，覆蓋範圍天生是完整的 2π，但效率由偏振轉換率決定且會把未轉換光留在零階。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h. As the diameter grows from roughly 80 nm to 200 nm at 532 nm, n_eff rises from about 1.1 to 2.1, so pillars of fixed height sweep 2π by diameter alone. The alternative is geometric phase: pillars shaped as half-wave plates and rotated by θ impart φ = 2θ to circularly polarized light, covering a full 2π by construction, but efficiency is set by the polarization-conversion ratio and unconverted light stays in the zeroth order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ；Δn_eff = 1.0、h = 600 nm、λ = 532 nm 時 Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π，足以涵蓋一整圈並留餘裕；最細柱的深寬比為 600/80 = 7.5。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ; with Δn_eff = 1.0, h = 600 nm and λ = 532 nm, Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π, enough for a full cycle with margin; the thinnest pillar has an aspect ratio of 600/80 = 7.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋
knowledge.text: 每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。直徑從約 80 nm 增到 200 nm 時，532 nm 波長下 n_eff 約從 1.1 升到 2.1，因此固定高度 h 的柱子只靠直徑就能掃過 2π。
knowledge.textEn: Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h. As the diameter grows from roughly 80 nm to 200 nm at 532 nm, n_eff rises from about 1.1 to 2.1, so pillars of fixed height sweep 2π by diameter alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms" is correct?
options: 奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。
每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。
optionsEn: Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.
Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h.
quiz.explanation: 每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ；Δn_eff = 1.0、h = 600 nm、λ = 532 nm 時 Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π，足以涵蓋一整圈並留餘裕；最細柱的深寬比為 600/80 = 7.5。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ; with Δn_eff = 1.0, h = 600 nm and λ = 532 nm, Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π, enough for a full cycle with margin; the thinnest pillar has an aspect ratio of 600/80 = 7.5. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ；Δn_eff = 1.0、h = 600 nm、λ = 532 nm 時 Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π，足以涵蓋一整圈並留餘裕；最細柱的深寬比為 600/80 = 7.5。
knowledge.textEn: Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ; with Δn_eff = 1.0, h = 600 nm and λ = 532 nm, Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π, enough for a full cycle with margin; the thinnest pillar has an aspect ratio of 600/80 = 7.5.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms", which statement holds?
options: 相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ。
穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。
平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。
optionsEn: Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ.
A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.
A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.
quiz.explanation: 相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ；Δn_eff = 1.0、h = 600 nm、λ = 532 nm 時 Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π，足以涵蓋一整圈並留餘裕；最細柱的深寬比為 600/80 = 7.5。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ; with Δn_eff = 1.0, h = 600 nm and λ = 532 nm, Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π, enough for a full cycle with margin; the thinnest pillar has an aspect ratio of 600/80 = 7.5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。
knowledge.textEn: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫。
平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically.
Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：另一條路是幾何相位：把柱子做成半波片並旋轉角度 θ，對圓偏振光給出 φ = 2θ，覆蓋範圍天生是完整的 2π，但效率由偏振轉換率決定且會把未轉換光留在零階。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The alternative is geometric phase: pillars shaped as half-wave plates and rotated by θ impart φ = 2θ to circularly polarized light, covering a full 2π by construction, but efficiency is set by the polarization-conversion ratio and unconverted light stays in the zeroth order.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。
knowledge.textEn: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。
若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.
A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap.
quiz.explanation: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
